verdict.rationale: Deel exposes a REST API (contracts, payroll, EOR data) and an OAuth install flow for building integrations that reach '40,000+ Deel customers,' which shows some API-based embedding capability, but nothing in the evidence describes a true white-label/partner-branded payroll offering (i.e., hiding Deel branding so a developer can resell payroll as their own product). Missing for 10: explicit white-label/reseller program documentation, branding customization options, and partner agreement terms confirming white-label use.
